quotes.name: Bobby Chen-Ramirez
quotes.quote: Look, I run a health center project, not a spreadsheet. But I walk that block every day, and I see the same thing you're describing — the numbers on the wall don't mean a damn thing if Mrs. Okafor still can't get her blood pressure checked without taking two buses. What creates accountability for me is simple: I've got 14 employees on my roster, and every one of them lives in this neighborhood. When I see hiring signs in every storefront on the Jack London corridor, I want to know who's actually getting those jobs — is it the kid who grew up here, or is it somebody who commutes in from the hills? That's the story. That's what I want answered. Because if growth just means the ledger gets fatter while the sidewalk stays the same, then we're building a ghost town with good accounting.
